questions.markdown: Derive the relation between the scattering angle and the Compton shift in wavelength of X-rays, when X-rays bombarded with target metal.
Calculate the V-number for a fiber of core diameter 40 micro meter and refractive index of 1.55 and 1.50 respectively for its core and cladding when a light of wavelength 1400 nm is propagating.
Is lasing action possible with only two levels (e.g. a two level system)? Justify your answer.
Obtain the general solution of the Schrodinger equation for a particle of mass $m$ trapped in a potential well of infinite height.
What is the working principle of an optical fibre? Obtain an expression for numerical aperture.
The speed of an electron is measured to be $5.00 \times 10^3\ \text{m/s}$ to an accuracy of $0.0030\%$. Find the minimum uncertainty in determining the position of this electron.
Apply the Hadamard gate to the qubit state $a|0\rangle+b|1\rangle$, where $a$ and $b$ are arbitrary complex amplitudes. Show the resulting state in terms of $a$ and $b$.
Calculate the number of photons emitted for 10 seconds by a FM radio transmitter of frequency 99.7 MHz with output power of 150 kW.
Show that $|+\rangle=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\begin{pmatrix}1\\1\end{pmatrix}$ and $|-\rangle=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\begin{pmatrix}1\\-1\end{pmatrix}$ are orthonormal basis in Hilbert space.
